name: Himitsu no Ritsuya-kun
source:
The protagonist, "You", has a childhood friend named Suzumori Ritsuya.
Ritsuya always calls You ugly and makes nasty remarks about your appearance.
However, You know a "secret" that Ritsuya doesn't want anyone to discover, and, taking advantage of this weakness, You decide to r*pe him!?
